name: smwmusic-41-soy-sauce-rivers-txt
title: 41 Soy Sauce Rivers.txt
description:
A few people wanted me to submit it. Basically it's "the song" where (hypothetically) you find a deeper part of Vanilla Dome. What awaits is the oily "Soy Sauce Rivers" where Bowser's Doomships are manufactured.

Pianos are used to provide an off-putting vibe; a deceptively simple melody where the second piano breaks at the end for the conclusion.

Fits submaps mainly.
